summary: 44 units reviewed. Errors: unit 10 (kāla-āyasīm split), 21 (camū-khala given an invented sense), 23 (-āḥ read as accusative object), 25 (Hindi and English give different readings; mayi as 'from me'), 36 (vayu-cāre glossed).
